name: VA-08
label: Safe D

key_factors: Deeply Democratic district with a +26 partisan lean
Beyer is a well-funded incumbent with $2.1M raised and $839K on hand
Republican challenger raised only ~$22K, with no outside spending
Prediction markets price Beyer at ~96% to win
model.rationale: Don Beyer holds a Northern Virginia seat with a +26 Democratic lean, has vastly out-raised Tony Sabio, and markets price him near-certain to win. With no polls or expert ratings suggesting competition, the forecast stays firmly in Safe D territory.
model.watch: Any late outside spending or polling showing a single-digit race would warrant a relook, but nothing in the evidence points that way.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Don Beyer seeks another term in a Northern Virginia district that leans heavily Democratic, about 26 points more Democratic than the nation. He enters with a large financial edge, having raised roughly $2.1 million and holding $839,000 on hand, while Republican Tony Sabio has raised about $22,000. No outside groups are active in the race, and no public polls are available.

Prediction markets give Beyer roughly a 96 percent chance of winning, and the seat's fundamentals point the same direction. A Libertarian and an independent are also on the ballot but lack resources. Absent unexpected developments, this race is not expected to be competitive.
